description: This file defines the SharedFdKeymasterChannel class, which provides an interface for synchronous communication with the Keymaster service over shared file descriptors. It declares methods for sending requests and responses, and for receiving messages, utilizing shared file descriptor objects.

classes.name: SharedFdKeymasterChannel
classes.description: A class implementing the KeymasterChannel interface, facilitating communication over shared file descriptors for key management operations.

methods.name: SharedFdKeymasterChannel
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the channel with input and output shared file descriptors.

methods.name: SendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request message with a specified command and serializable message.

methods.name: SendResponse
methods.description: Sends a response message with a specified command and serializable message.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Receives a message from the input shared file descriptor.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Internal method to send a message with specified command and response flag, wrapping serializable message transmission.
